metadata.description: Mobile-app vulnerability-hunting bundle for Claude Code. Decompiles an APK/IPA, runs an LLM-SAST pipeline, and hunts 26 Android/iOS vulnerability classes ported from droid-llm-hunter's vuln_rules.

plugins.name: hunt-mobile
plugins.description: 27-skill mobile bug-hunting bundle — /hunt-mobile command + mhunt-dispatch pipeline orchestrator + 26 mhunt-* vuln-class skills (webview, IPC/exported components, deep links, storage/secrets, crypto, injection, code-exec, biometric, logic flaws). Decompiles APK/IPA, greps detection_patterns to auto-load the right skills, hunts statically + dynamically, maps findings to OWASP MASVS. Ported from droid-llm-hunter.
